title: 358. Factor Combinations

examples.explanation: 37 is prime, so it cannot be split into smaller factors above 1.
1 has no factor above 1 to build a combination from.

hints: Search depth-first, only trying divisors from the last chosen factor upward so each row stays non-decreasing.
When the remaining value is at least the current start, record current factors plus the remainder as one valid row.
